<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BuildingAHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-a-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Tree house requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Tree house draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsOrder" name="Materials order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderProcessed" name="Order processed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the house"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HouseBuilt" name="House built"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartyInvitation" name="Tree house party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingAHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect" processRef="Process_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online stores" processRef="Process_Stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends" processRef="Process_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Start_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Start_Stores"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderProcessed" sourceRef="Task_ProcessOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Start_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HouseBuilt" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartyInvitation" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Build a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_You" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePlan" name="Refine plan with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreRefinement" name="More refinement needed?" default="Flow_RefinementComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CategorizeMaterials" name="Categorize materials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from several online stores" messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Order processing and house building"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrderProcessed" name="Wait for order processing" messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" name="Ask friends to build the house" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveHouseBuilt" name="Wait for the house to be built" messageRef="Message_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Order and house building complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations" messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create attendee list for party snacks"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_You" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_1" sourceRef="Start_You" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_RefinePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_5" sourceRef="Task_RefinePlan" targetRef="Gateway_MoreRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefineAgain" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRefinement" targetRef="Task_RefinePlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreRefinementNeeded}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementComplete" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreRefinement" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_6" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_7" sourceRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_8" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrderProcessed" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_12" sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveHouseBuilt" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_14" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_15" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_16" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_You"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Architect" name="Architect prepares draft" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Architect" name="Requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArchitectRequirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDraft" name="Prepare draft"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Architect" name="Draft sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_1" sourceRef="Start_Architect" targetRef="Task_PrepareDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDraft" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_3" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="End_Architect"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Stores" name="Process materials order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Stores" name="Materials order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_StoresOrder" messageRef="Message_MaterialsOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessOrder" name="Process materials order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrderProcessed" name="Send order processing completion" messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Stores" name="Order processed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stores_1" sourceRef="Start_Stores" targetRef="Task_ProcessOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stores_2" sourceRef="Task_ProcessOrder" targetRef="Task_SendOrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stores_3" sourceRef="Task_SendOrderProcessed" targetRef="End_Stores"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Friends" name="Friends build the house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Friends" name="Request to build received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FriendsBuildRequest" messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendHouseBuilt" name="Send house completion" messageRef="Message_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Friends" name="House built"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friends_1" sourceRef="Start_Friends" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friends_2" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendHouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friends_3" sourceRef="Task_SendHouseBuilt" targetRef="End_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
